claim: no USAPL Raw Nationals ele bateu PRs e levou um recorde americano
verbatim: I had a great time set some PRS and even took a uh an American record which I was very happy with

claim: ele teve um leve misgroove no agacho de 689 lb, que ainda assim se moveu bem
verbatim: I had a slight misgroove on this 689 but it's still moved really well

claim: revendo a filmagem, as tentativas estavam subindo muito mais rápido do que pareciam para ele na plataforma
verbatim: as I looked back over the footage uh things were moving so much faster than they felt when I was out on the platform uh things felt really slow to me

claim: nesse agacho ele teve uma leve frouxidão no fundo e o quadril saltou para trás
verbatim: I had a slight little uh uh uh looseness at the bottom of that squat you'll see where my hips popped back out

claim: ele acertou 705 lb no agacho e nunca tinha pegado esse peso tão rápido, especialmente nesse peso corporal
verbatim: but I came back with this 705 and I have never hit uh this weight this fast before um especially at this body weight

claim: na segunda tentativa de supino ele pegou a barra um pouco mais à esquerda do que deveria com a mão esquerda
verbatim: I think I gripped the bar just a little bit further to the left than I should have with my left hand

claim: o resultado dessa pegada desalinhada foi travar o braço direito um pouco antes do esquerdo
verbatim: you'll see it comes up just slightly uneven here where I lock out my right arm

claim: ele achava que 501 lb estaria lá, mas a força do tríceps esquerdo não estava e ele não terminou a repetição
verbatim: I did think 501 was going to be there but as it turned out my left tricep strength just was not there tried to adjust but uh was not able to finish this rep

claim: quando as costas começaram a sair do banco ele balançou a cabeça em não, para seguir adiante e salvar as costas para o terra
verbatim: but started to come up off the bench shook my head no needed to move on and save my back

claim: mesmo assim as costas dele ficaram bem travadas depois de perder aquele supino
verbatim: but even after that my back was pretty cramped up uh after missing that bench I had strained a lot

claim: no terra ele abriu em 661 lb e subiu para o segundo planejado de 700 lb
verbatim: 661 opener blue uh moved up to my plan second which was 700

claim: ele e Bryce Lewis alternavam tentativas de terra, e cada tentativa dele forçava o adversário a subir mais uma
verbatim: Bryce Lewis and I were going kind of tip Fort uh with our deadlifts each deadlift attempt that I did uh was forcing him to go uh one Higher deadlift

claim: ele terminou puxando 722 lb no terra
verbatim: and so I ended up pulling 722

claim: o adversário puxou a tentativa e o venceu por meio quilo no total
verbatim: but anyways he did in fact pull it beat me out by half a kilogram on the total

claim: ele foi 8 de 9 tentativas válidas e ainda assim bateu PR de total, superando um dia anterior em que tinha ido 9 de 9
verbatim: and to go 8 for n and still a 7 1 12 kg total PR over a 9 for9 day was really encouraging

claim: com o nascimento da filha muitas prioridades dele mudaram e ele teve que se ajustar
verbatim: with the birth of my daughter so many of my priorities have shifted so much of my time has changed and I've just really had to adjust

claim: quatro ou cinco meses antes da competição ele nem ia disputar o Raw Nationals
verbatim: about fall uh four or five months ago I wasn't even going to Raw Nationals

claim: quatro ou cinco meses antes da competição ele estava pelo menos 15% mais fraco do que o total que fez no Nationals daquele ano
verbatim: I was at least 15% weaker than what I totaled at Nationals this year and was really demotivated

claim: desmotivado, ele manteve a cabeça baixa e continuou treinando de forma consistente até conseguir voltar e melhorar
verbatim: but kept my head down kept training consistently and was able to come back and improve

claim: ele melhorou algo em torno de 70 lb no total em relação ao Nationals do ano anterior
verbatim: I think something like 70 lbs over my total last year at Nationals so very excited
